summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with fixture-based valid, invalid, and non-node tests. All 41 tests pass (20 new SHACL tests plus the unmodified test/test_path.py suite). Deviation from spec: added an explicit Node isinstance guard, since None would otherwise act as a wildcard in graph lookups. Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting were checked by reading only (no lines over 88 columns). Nothing committed.
